verdict.rationale: ScrapingBee's JavaScript scenario lets a developer script clicks and form fills inside its headless browser before the HTML is returned, so a login form could be completed within one request. Nothing shows a developer can keep interacting with a page after it has been scraped: session_id only reuses an IP, and cookies only pass custom cookies, not a live browser state. Missing for 10: persistent browser sessions across calls, a documented login-wall or auth workflow, and independent hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can keep interacting with an already-scraped page, clicking and filling forms to reach content behind a login wall

citations.quote: If you want to interact with pages you want to scrape before we return your the HTML you can add JavaScript scenario to your API call.
Pass custom cookies to the webpage you want to scrape
